questions.stem: What happens to the other components in a series circuit if one component breaks?

options.text: The other components continue to work normally
The other components receive more current
All components stop working because the circuit is broken
Only components before the break stop working

questions.explanation: In a series circuit, there is only one path for current. If any component breaks, the circuit is broken and current stops flowing through all components. This is a key disadvantage of series circuits.
